asset.description: Compact rounded white porcelain directory holder with exactly three blank semi-transparent glass cards and two blue-glass data cubes.

Exactly three blank frosted translucent ice-blue rounded rectangular cards stand in those slots, gently staggered in height and depth, with their top corners visible as three distinct layers. A pair of small rounded blue glass data cubes sits neatly adjacent to the rack's lower front. One unified orderly cluster, resembling a small file archive organizer.

Polished gentle reflections, restrained blue edge highlights and a subtle cyan-blue glint in the glass.

A strong clear silhouette with simple large forms and three individually readable cards at a small display size.
